visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a medium close-up of a young woman with long brown hair, wearing a light blue baseball cap and black-rimmed glasses. She is standing inside a brightly lit LEGO store, where the background is filled with blurred shelves of colorful toy boxes and other shoppers moving around. (2) She holds up a colorful LEGO box to the camera, then transitions to showing her hands interacting with a large digital touchscreen labeled "MINIFIGURE FACTORY." The store environment features bright yellow walls and white lighting, typical of a modern flagship retail space with high ceilings. (3) On the touchscreen, the woman uses her finger to navigate a customization menu, typing the words "Better Bio" on a virtual keyboard and drawing a yellow logo on a virtual minifigure. The interface is colorful, and she is shown precisely tapping the screen to select different design elements. (4) The scene shifts to a specialized LEGO printing machine behind a glass panel, where several small yellow LEGO torsos are seen being printed on a mechanical tray. In the next moment, she is seen at a large circular bin filled with loose LEGO heads and accessories. (5) A final close-up reveals the completed LEGO minifigure, which has a custom printed shirt and a large alpaca-style headpiece, presented inside its official cardboard packaging. The video ends with the woman speaking directly to the camera, showing various facial expressions that convey a mix of humor and slight annoyance.
